title: Router Middleware
definition: Router-level middleware works in exactly the same way as application-level middleware, except it is bound to an instance of `express.Router()` instead of `express()`. This is useful for applying specific middleware (like Auth checks) only to a specific group of routes.

answers.question: When should you avoid using Router Middleware?
answers.answer: It depends on the specific architectural requirements and performance bottlenecks of your application. Overusing it can sometimes lead to tightly coupled code.
